items.name: Approval Card
items.line: A checklist a person ticks and signs off.

items.name: Form
items.line: Fields a reader fills in, and one act Flow records after asking.

items.name: Job Form
items.line: A Form whose button sets up a Job for this document.

items.name: Table
items.line: A table drawn from the rows the block names; the first row's keys are the columns.

items.name: Chart
items.line: A chart drawn in place from a readable body: the chart's type, title, rows and which field goes on which axis.

items.name: Diagram
items.line: A diagram drawn from its text, in Mermaid's language.

items.name: Image
items.line: A picture from the document's folder, with the sentence a screen reader says (required) and an optional caption.

items.name: Diff
items.line: Exact changes, drawn the way Review Changes draws them, red for removed and green for added.

items.name: Folder
items.line: A folder's files as a table.

items.name: Callout
items.line: A note or a warning in the Reader's own style: a bar, a mark and the word, so the kind never rests on colour alone.

items.name: Change Summary
items.line: What changed in this document lately, in History's words, newest first, with who and which day beside each line and Show in History for the rest.

items.name: Sources
items.line: What this document was made from, as History records it: each source, how it was used and when, with a changed source marked.

items.name: Section
items.line: Section groups components under a title.

items.name: Hero
items.line: Hero holds exactly two, side by side at every width: a chart beside the figures it rests on stays a pair even in a narrow window.

items.name: Bento
items.line: Bento holds two or more, two across at most, and stacks when the column is narrow.

items.name: Proofread
items.line: Fixes spelling, grammar and punctuation; shows every change

items.name: Summarize
items.line: Condenses the text to its points

items.name: Translate
items.line: Rewrites the text in another language

items.name: Convert Text to Table
items.line: Turns prose into a table

items.name: Convert Table to Text
items.line: Turns a table into prose

items.name: Expand with Sources
items.line: Grows a draft from its sources, citing each

items.name: Research Brief
items.line: Turns an idea into the brief a draft is written from

items.name: Visualize
items.line: Proposes a chart or diagram from the selected text

items.name: Sign-off
items.line: Drafts an Approval Card from the selected text

items.name: Form
items.line: Drafts a form with one act from the selected text

items.name: Describe Picture
items.line: Writes alt text for the picture under the caret

items.name: Generate Picture
items.line: Makes a picture from the selected text

items.name: Architecture Diagram
items.line: The parts of a system, where they run, and what flows between.

items.name: Decision Brief
items.line: The decision, the options, a recommendation and its sources.

items.name: Delegation Map
items.line: Who does each step, and where the work changes hands.

items.name: Field-Notes Diagram
items.line: A technical idea's numbers drawn to scale, field-notes style.

items.name: Guided Exercise
items.line: A passage turned into steps a learner works through and signs.

items.name: Isometric Figure
items.line: A layered stack in depth; press a layer to read what it does.

items.name: Landscape Map
items.line: Who is in a market or field, grouped, with each one's source.

items.name: Opportunity Map
items.line: Initiatives placed by value and effort, with the case for each.

items.name: Option Comparison
items.line: Options side by side on the facts that tell them apart.

items.name: Path Card
items.line: A feature on one card: who it is for, the steps, the path, proof.

items.name: Product Mock
items.line: A user journey played out in a mock of the product's window.

items.name: Register
items.line: Risks, issues or decisions logged with an owner and a check.

items.name: Roadmap
items.line: Work laid out over time, by workstream, with its milestones.

items.name: Scenario Model
items.line: Low, base and high cases from stated ranges, and a choice.

items.name: Scorecard
items.line: Each candidate scored against weighted criteria, then signed off.

items.name: System Explainer
items.line: A system's parts, its flows, and what a failure changes.

items.name: Value Model
items.line: The value a change creates, from its stated assumptions.

items.name: Visual Explainer
items.line: One idea from the text, drawn so it builds step by step.

items.name: Workflow Path
items.line: A workflow drawn as what goes in, the work, and what comes out.

items.name: Bar chart
items.line: Compare a modest set of amounts on one shared unit.

items.name: Grouped bar chart
items.line: Compare the same categories under two or three conditions.

items.name: Stacked bar chart
items.line: Compare totals and their components together.

items.name: Lollipop chart
items.line: Keep a longer category list light while preserving individual amounts.

items.name: Bar table
items.line: Read exact values alongside their relative size.

items.name: Pyramid chart
items.line: Compare two cohorts across the same bands.

items.name: Bullet chart
items.line: Compare an actual value with its own target.

items.name: KPI card
items.line: Give one important measure a clear value, unit and comparison.

items.name: Line chart
items.line: Compare observations in time order.

items.name: Area chart
items.line: Emphasize the amount of a volume or balance over time.

items.name: Streamgraph
items.line: Explore how several parts change over time.

items.name: Range area chart
items.line: Show a supplied lower and upper range.

items.name: Sparkline
items.line: Place a compact trend beside a statement.

items.name: Slope chart
items.line: Compare exactly two named periods for each item.

items.name: Bump chart
items.line: Track rank changes across periods.

items.name: Connected scatter plot
items.line: Follow one entity through time on two quantitative axes.

items.name: Candlestick chart
items.line: Show an opening value, high, low and closing value for each period.

items.name: Calendar heatmap
items.line: Read daily rhythm across weeks and months.

items.name: Waterfall chart
items.line: Reconcile an opening amount through signed movements to a closing amount.

items.name: Pie chart
items.line: Show a few nonnegative parts of a single meaningful whole.

items.name: Donut chart
items.line: Use a compact part-to-whole view with a clear total nearby.

items.name: Rose chart
items.line: Explore ordered cyclical categories such as weekdays.

items.name: Radar chart
items.line: Compare a few profiles on shared criteria.

items.name: Gantt chart
items.line: Show authored start and finish dates, overlaps and handovers.

items.name: Scatter plot
items.line: Look for a relationship between two measures on the same rows.

items.name: Regression
items.line: Summarize the fitted relationship between two numeric measures.

items.name: Histogram
items.line: Inspect the distribution of one measure.

items.name: Density plot
items.line: Compare smoothed distribution shapes.

items.name: ECDF plot
items.line: Ask what share of observations is at or below a threshold.

items.name: Boxplot
items.line: Compare medians, quartiles and flagged outliers across groups.

items.name: Violin plot
items.line: Compare the shape of distributions, including possible multiple peaks.

items.name: Strip plot
items.line: Show every observation in a modest sample.

items.name: Ranged dot plot
items.line: Compare two observations for each item with less ink than paired bars.

items.name: Heatmap
items.line: Inspect a matrix of two categories and a numeric measure.

items.name: Flowchart
items.line: Explain steps and decisions, including the paths a person can take.

items.name: Sequence diagram
items.line: Show actors exchanging messages in order.

items.name: State diagram
items.line: Define allowed states and the events between them.

items.name: Class diagram
items.line: Describe conceptual entities, their fields and relationships.

items.name: Entity-relationship diagram
items.line: Describe records, keys and relationships.

items.name: Gantt (diagram)
items.line: Write a dependency-oriented schedule as text.

items.name: User journey
items.line: Summarize a sequence of tasks and an explicitly subjective experience rating.

items.name: Pie (diagram)
items.line: Show a few embedded amounts within a diagram.

items.name: Quadrant chart
items.line: Discuss items scored on two explicit axes.

items.name: Timeline
items.line: Present dated milestones in order.

items.name: Mindmap
items.line: Turn a nested outline into a navigable conceptual structure.

items.name: Git graph
items.line: Explain a small branch-and-merge history.

items.name: Sankey diagram
items.line: Follow amounts between named stages.

items.name: XY chart (diagram)
items.line: Combine simple embedded bar and line series using one explained axis.

items.name: Block diagram
items.line: Arrange a small set of components to explain responsibilities.

items.name: Requirement diagram
items.line: Connect an authored requirement to its proposed verification and components.

items.name: C4 context diagram
items.line: Show people, a system and its external neighbours.

items.name: Kanban board
items.line: Group an authored task list by status.

items.name: Architecture diagram
items.line: Describe services, stores and deployment groups.

items.name: Packet diagram
items.line: Describe the bit layout of a fictional binary header.
